about:
Furnished flat share !
    --------------------------------
    All our flats are located in the city centre and close to all amenities
    and public transport (Metro, Tramway and Bus).
    ---------
    This lovely private bedroom in a fully equipped, furnished and all-inclusive flatshare in Lyon is a perfect combination of comfort and design. It has many household items, including a double bed with pillows and duvet Now all you need is to bring your things to settle in well! The room has a lock if you need intimacy.
    All our rooms are fully furnished (bed, desk, wardrobe, duvet, pillows...).
    ---------
    The flatshare can be found in the "Jean Macé" neighborhood, in the heart of Lyon. A lot of restaurants, shops, public transports are available near at hand. The apartment is on floor #7 , with elevator. It is entirely equipped and is composed of a complete kitchen with fridge, toaster, microwave, pans, crockery, kettle, kitchen ustensils… The flat also has a clothes rack, an iron, a washing machine, an ironing board.
 You will also find cleaning items in the flatshare: mop and bucket, bagless hoover, broom, dustpan and brush… Every furnished flatshare includes all expenses: household waste tax, condominium fees, water, unlimited wi-fi, housing insurance, electricity.
    All our flats are fully equipped (washing machine, dishes, decoration...)
    by our teams, who also take care of the technical and material maintenance.
    ---------
    The Jean Macé neighbourhood in Lyon's 7th arrondissement is mainly residential, blooming with flowers and open spaces. The district where this lovely furnished flatshare is located, has many public service buildings around the main square which hosts a large food market on Wednesdays and Saturdays. As the neighbourhood is near some of Lyon's biggest universities, many students have made it their home and numerous bars and night clubs can be found here (notably on rue Chevreul). Similarly, you can stumble upon parks, football fields, or calm terraces around almost every street corner. With trains, the subway, buses and trams all connecting here, this area is one of the best-served by public transport. 
    ---------
    Minimum stay : 1 mois
    Apartment eligible for CAF up to 258€ / month. The CAF for Caisse
    d'allocations familiales is a free public service eligible for all,
    including foreigners and can help you financially to pay part of your
    housing according to your situation whether you are French or foreign. To
    find out the potential amount of your assistance, go to the CAF website and
    complete the online APL (housing assistance) estimate.
    Service fee : from 890€
    The service fee covers the writing of the lease but also the assistance
    throughout your stay. The service fee covers the repair and maintenance of
    the equipment as well as access to our ultra-reactive support in case of
    need for intervention in your accommodation.
    Deposit : 900€
